timing.label: Objection 2 (technical)
timing.question: Why do the two dashboards show different totals?

problem.quote: So Harbourline has three organizations, and a contract that renews monthly, and there are tiers

approach.quote: there are two limits, the organization one and the personal one

evidence.quote: Trailhead used 3,000, Lumen 4,100, Platform 1,770, the enterprise 8,870, and the sale adds 900

next_step.quote: Ask: can you approve the new Trailhead limit?

tag_question_examples: The empty report means no billing cycle for those dates, right?

must_mention.point: Organization limit and per-user tier are enforced independently; either one blocks, and raising one never lifts the other
must_mention.evidence_quote: there are two limits, the organization one and the personal one, and they are enforced independently, so either one can block you

must_mention.point: The Trailhead lead is at 180 of 400 on her tier but Trailhead is at 3,000 of 3,000, so only an enterprise admin raising the org limit helps
must_mention.evidence_quote: Trailhead is at 3,000 of 3,000, so she is blocked by the organization and an admin has to raise the org limit

must_mention.point: The per-user meter counts cloud plus local usage and leaves Devin Review out; the org limit includes Review
must_mention.evidence_quote: at 410, which is cloud plus local, and Review is not counted for him

must_mention.point: Limits reset on the contract day, the 23rd, after the 18–20 Nov sale, and temporary overrides expire then
Newest vs Legacy is the gear-icon Version setting; Cloud-only metrics exclude local usage; the empty state means no billing cycle in range
must_mention.evidence_quote: a Cloud-only number from the Newest version in the gear menu, so it has no local usage. The empty report means no billing cycle for those dates

must_mention.point: A tier applies to each member, not a pooled team budget; a team cap is an organization-level limit
must_mention.evidence_quote: a tier is per member, not a team budget, so the team cap you want is the organization limit

must_mention.point: The finance update carried exactly three ACU figures, each with the view it came from

repeated_words: "and" chained five times in the framing
article_plural_slips: "raise the org limit" — say "the organization limit" to finance
sentences_to_rerecord: So Harbourline has three organizations, and a contract that renews monthly, and there are tiers, and IdP groups…

accuracy.anchor: Five of seven points; the reset day after the sale (mm4) and the three sourced figures (mm7) missing (anchor: 16–21 = most points, two missing).

structure.anchor: Backstory before the outcome in the framing; the update had no Risk heading (anchor: 13–17 = order partly held).

customer_relevance.anchor: Numbers present but five figures in one sentence and none with its view (anchor: 12–15 = numbers present, buried).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Framing 10 s over, checkpoint-10, the update and both objections under; five fillers, one tag question, an 11 s pause (anchor: 7–9 = several segments off).

recovery.anchor: Objection 1 opened with "No"; objection 2 acknowledged but deferred the evidence (anchor: 5–7 = pattern held once, partly).

stems: "She was under her own cap; the organization was not." — open the framing with the outcome, not the org chart.
"The reset is on the 23rd; the sale ends on the 20th." — your update had no risk sentence; this is it.
"Three numbers: … from …, … from …, … from …" — one figure per sentence, each with its view.
